body.statement: For \(H=L=\gamma=1\) and \(\mathcal S_{\mathrm{TIV}}\), the certificate in \(\text{def:tiv-rational-certificate}\) satisfies \(p^{\star}\in\mathcal P_{\mathcal S,H,L}^{+}\) and \([\underline q(p^{\star}),\overline q(p^{\star})]=[57/200,137/200]\subsetneq[-79/400,321/400]=[\underline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p^{\star}),\overline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p^{\star})]\). The graph-aware masses \(\lambda^{-}\) and \(\lambda^{+}\) reproduce \(p^{\star}\) and attain the first two extrema; the sixteen pointwise inequalities induced by \(h^{-}\) and \(h^{+}\) certify their optimality. The complete eight-row common-latent signature tables \(\xi_{zxy}^{-}\) and \(\xi_{zxy}^{+}\), tensored with their displayed fair nuisance completions, reproduce \(p^{\star}\) and attain the order-only extrema; the two pointwise complete-signature inequalities certify their optimality. The exact rank-seven matrix \(M^{\star}\), the strictly positive \(\lambda^{\circ}\), and the full-support nuisance table form the interior witness used for stability. There exists a rational \(\delta>0\) such that for every \(p\in\mathcal N_{\delta}(p^{\star})\), \(\underline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p)<\underline q(p)\le\overline q(p)<\overline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p)\).
body.justification: Four exact primal and dual ledgers certify that the summary graph strictly narrows the single complete temporal-order common-latent envelope, while the interior ledger makes the gain robust in the stated relative topology.
body.gap: RossettoAntonucci2026 proves tight order-only bounds over complete causal-order response signatures, while Bellot2024 shows that partial graphical information can improve natural bounds; neither gives a refinement-to-complete-order embedding, four exact endpoint certificates, or a relative-open temporal micro-CDE separation.
body.consumer: Domain experts can quantify the value of supplying a summary graph against one maximally permissive temporal-order SCM and detect when its restrictions materially change a direct-effect conclusion.
